newsitem.title: USA: Delaware approves General Re merger.
newsitem.headline: Delaware approves General Re merger.

text.p: General Re Corp said Tuesday that Delaware's Insurance Commissioner has approved a planned merger between it and National Re Corp.
General Re, the largest professional reinsurer in the United States, said approval from the commissioner in Connecticut was still pending.
It also said the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission had approved the registration statement explaining the merger.
National Re shareholders are to meet September 30 to decide whether to accept the merger and receive cash or General Re shares.
General Re said it expected to close the merger early in the fourth quarter of this year if it won approval from the commissioner and shareholders.
National Re provides property and casualty reinsurance to primary insurers.
National Re and General Re are both based in Stamford, Conn. General Re is incorporated in Delaware.
